name: 1inch Business Agent
description: Agent interface for the 1inch Business Web3 API platform: documentation search, SDK examples, swap quotes & execution (Classic, Fusion, cross-chain), limit orders, and product APIs (portfolio, prices, token, gas) across 14+ chains. Implemented as a remote MCP server.

oauth2.description: OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow via the 1inch Business Portal. Required for swap, orderbook, and product API skills; documentation skills are public.

skills.name: Search documentation
skills.description: Search the 1inch Business documentation and API reference (Typesense-backed). Public, read-only.
examples: How do I integrate the 1inch Fusion swap API?

skills.name: List SDK examples
skills.description: List available 1inch SDK code examples. Public, read-only.

skills.name: Get SDK example source
skills.description: Fetch the full source of a 1inch SDK code example by id. Public, read-only.
examples: Show me the cross-chain swap SDK example

skills.name: Aqua strategy analytics
skills.description: Read 1inch Aqua shared-liquidity analytics: maker TVL, fees and APY, a maker's strategies, and per-strategy state, on-chain activity and volume series. Public, read-only.
examples: What is the TVL and APY for Aqua maker 0x1234...?
List the currently open Aqua strategies on Base

skills.name: Swap tokens (best rate, gasless, cross-chain)
skills.description: Quote and execute token swaps for the best on-chain rate. Classic (DEX aggregation via Pathfinder), Fusion (gasless, intent-based, MEV-protected Dutch auction), and Fusion+ (cross-chain without bridges, incl. EVM to Solana). Requires authentication.
examples: Get me a quote to swap 1000 USDC to DAI on Ethereum
What's the best rate to swap 2 ETH for USDC?
Swap 500 USDC to ETH gas-free with MEV protection
Bridge 1000 USDC from Ethereum to Solana

skills.name: Orderbook (limit orders)
skills.description: Build, create, list, and cancel limit orders. Requires authentication.
examples: List my open limit orders on Ethereum

skills.name: Product API proxy
skills.description: Authenticated proxy to 1inch product APIs: portfolio, spot prices, token metadata, gas prices and more.

skills.name: WalletConnect (EVM)
skills.description: Non-custodial WalletConnect flow: pair a wallet, sign messages, and send transactions; execute swaps and orders when a session is active. Requires authentication.
examples: Connect my wallet and send the swap transaction

skills.name: Request log lookup
skills.description: Look up recent 1inch API request logs for troubleshooting. Authenticated, read-only.
examples: Why did my last swap request fail?
